implementation.sceneRegistration: Existing source-registered KeeperGestureView and HallAmbienceView; no screen-space duplicate character or whole-mascot scaling.
implementation.progressFixture: Existing ui-wide-ticket + button-gold; fill is cropped inner core of generated fx-gilded-light at [96,180,324,188]. Runtime cropped SpriteFrame is released by its owner.
implementation.progressMeaning: Smoothed completed prerequisite groups, after the existing generated loading scene has been available. Cache-ready phase shows ready/entering copy, not a fabricated timed 0-to-100 load.

implementation.startup: Original global startup loading retained; debug direct-game startup also gets selected-room entry. Returning from rules to the same cabinet does not restart room loading.
